body.p: To manually install the add-on, follow these instructions:

ol.li: Go to Help Install new add-ons to open the add-on selection dialog box.
Paste https://www.oxygenxml.com/InstData/Addons/community/updateSite.xml in the Show add-ons from field (or select it from the drop-down menu).
Select the XSpec Helper View and XSpec Framework add-ons (both are required), and click Next.
